newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares ease, seen rebounding next week.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares ease, seen rebounding next week.

text.p: Slovenian shares eased 0.27 percent on Friday with participants reluctant to take up fresh positions ahead of a long weekend.
Traders said prices could firm as soon as next week due to lower bank deposit interest rates that will be introduced from April 1.
"Because of lower deposit interest rates some domestic investors may decide to move money into shares," said Mateja Gubanec, a trader at bank A banka.
* The SBI index fell 3.43 points to 1,274.26.
* Food company Kolinska had the highest turnover, down 4.19 percent to 2,010 tolars on volume of 12,123 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
